target: Anclaje geográfico del ramal A del Paso del Dosel Alto.
art_direction: SUBJECT TYPE: LOCATION / ENVIRONMENT / LANDSCAPE — NO CREATURE. Abertura rocosa parcialmente oculta por vegetación y claramente distinta de una mina. Solo se representa la boca exterior; futura mazmorra no definida.
prompt: SUBJECT TYPE: LOCATION / ENVIRONMENT / LANDSCAPE — NO CREATURE. Create a wide exterior landscape of Boca de la Montaña on the upper Nhal–Hoshai transition. A natural rock opening sits where forest roots and vegetation cling to a steep stony slope. The entrance is irregular, weathered and partly screened by ordinary branches and foliage, but large enough to suggest a natural passage into the mountain. Its visible interior ends quickly in neutral darkness; do not reveal chambers or construction. Surrounding terrain combines wet forest roots below with colder exposed mountain rock above, making it unmistakably a transition-zone formation rather than a mine.
negative_constraints: No mine rails, beams, cut tunnel, masonry doorway or quarry scars

CATEGORY LOCK: location/landscape only; geography is the primary subject.
